title: Each of the four reports shows its chart above the report table
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. The location has sales and technician time this year.
  5. If a report shows Show Chart at the right of its toolbar, click it once so the chart is shown.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 unless a later line says otherwise.
  • For 4: check: on Reports > Sales with Date: This year, the table has rows. If not, create one invoice with clocked time: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer); Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = Tech ShopView, Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; then the Service Advisor is filled in with your name (Admin ShopView); to use another advisor change Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; clock time as the technician: in a second browser or a private window, on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Tech (this signs you in as Tech ShopView, a technician at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 with Time Clock on); open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start; when done click Stop > Clock Out; to make the time exact, as Admin: the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice).
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar.
  2. In the left menu click Sales and read the page from the toolbar down.
  3. Click Advisor Analysis and read the page.
  4. Click Technician Efficiency and read the page.
  5. Click Technician Utilization and read the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Sales shows the Revenue chart (monthly revenue bars) above its invoice table.
  • Service Advisor Analysis shows the Billing Efficiency chart (one line per advisor) above its table.
  • Technician Efficiency shows the Technician Efficiency chart (one line per technician) above its table.
  • Technician Utilization shows the Technician Utilization chart (one line per technician) above its table.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9583 (Story 11, Chart on the Report Page); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 11. Context note listing the report-to-chart pairings. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 10_sales_After, 11_service-advisor-analysis_After, 12_technician-efficiency_After and 13_technician-utilization_After, used for on-screen labels only.
